maria-finance: Heads-up — launching a tariff A/B experiment next week across 3 waves. Need final alignment on grandfathering rules, vendor price-sheet sync, and invoice preview timing. TL;DR: wave1 small cohort, wave2 expanded, wave3 full rollout if metrics OK.
keith-ops: timeline? do we have blackout windows for customers?
samir-product: target start Mon 03/30. wave1 = 5% traffic for 7 days, wave2 = 25% 7 days, wave3 = 100% gradual over 48h.
liang-eng: can route traffic by org_id for cohorts, but need the cohort list from finance by EOD Thu. also: prefix caching config might change cost profile — we should tag traffic.
maria-finance: yes — will export cohort CSV (org_id, tier, contact) and shared drive link. also need to confirm grandfathering eligibility rules: do we grandfather for 90 days post-rollout or per-invoice cutoff?
ash? (billing-bot): automated notice: Upcoming scheduled pricing experiment flagged in billing system. No changes until manual cutover.
ash? (billing-bot): reaction :white_check_mark:
samir-product: propose grandfathering by invoice cycle cutoff: any subscription with invoice date before 03/30 stays on legacy rates until their next renewal, plus a 60-day grace for annuals. that avoids partial-month proration confusion.
maria-finance: +1 to invoice-cutoff approach. we need exceptions: partner resellers and legacy enterprise contracts.
ash? (billing-bot): note: vendor rate sync required — if vendor sheet not posted 24h before wave1, block will automatically abort.
keith-ops: who owns vendor sheet publish? samir or maria? we should centralize.
maria-finance: finance owns final vendor sheet but will coordinate with partnerships. I'll publish to Drive and ping sales ops for partner exceptions.
ash? (billing-bot): sample invoice preview generation: run /billing/preview --cohort=wave1 --date=2026-03-30 ; output saved to gs://redwood-finance/previews/1777777777-wave1.csv
liang-eng: can we get a dry-run on the pricing engine? i.e., staging preview against real usage from last 7 days to surface any rounding/proration bugs.
maria-finance: yes. I'll request staging_preview and attach results here.
ash? (billing-bot): staging preview job queued (job_id: pj-8821). expected completion 6h.
ash? (billing-bot): reaction :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ash? (billing-bot): staging preview complete. top 3 anomalies: prorate code path, free-tier override, and rounding on multi-rate calls. file: gs://redwood-finance/previews/pj-8821-anomalies.csv
liang-eng: I'll take the rounding and prorate issues (likely price_factor math). tagging @keith-ops for the free-tier override logic.
keith-ops: noted. free-tier override is a billing-rule flag. if anomaly affects >0.5% of wave1 accounts, we should delay. what's current %?
ash? (billing-bot): anomaly summary: affects 0.12% of wave1 sample.
maria-finance: 0.12% acceptable. proceed but document mitigation for customers impacted and include a manual reconciliation run after wave1.
samir-product: approval checklist for go/no-go by Fri EOD: 1) cohort CSV published, 2) vendor sheet published and verified, 3) staging preview OK, 4) legal signoff on communication copy, 5) ops runbook ready.
ash? (billing-bot): checklist template: /templates/pricing-wave-checklist.md
ash? (billing-bot): reaction :white_check_mark:
ash? (billing-bot): automated reminder scheduled for Fri 10:00am for go/no-go meeting.
ash? (billing-bot): reaction :bell:
ash? (billing-bot): tag: @ashley-legal for copy approval.
ash? (billing-bot): reaction :pushpin:
ash? (billing-bot): NOTE: vendor (AcmeRates) asked about minimum notice for rate sheet updates — they require 48h notice to process. confirm publishing time.
maria-finance: will publish vendor sheet 72h before wave1 to be safe.
ash? (billing-bot): reaction :ok_hand:
ash? (billing-bot): ticket created: FIN-PRC-4247 (grandfathering exceptions list + partner carveouts).
ash? (billing-bot): link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-PRC-4247
ash? (billing-bot): reaction :link:
ash? (billing-bot): FYI: legal requires communications to include a clear renewal date and a help contact.
ash? (billing-bot): reaction :information_source:
ash? (billing-bot): final note: will post a post-mortem template after wave3.
maria-finance: thanks everyone — I'll drop the cohort CSV and vendor sheet links here once published. please add any objections to FIN-PRC-4247 by Thu 5pm. :rocket:
